patches.purpose: Separate reviewed source preparation from artifact construction; no source fixers or authoring generators in production build. Restrict inherited Pages deployment to upstream, not this source-stage fork.
patches.removalCondition: Upstream separates formatting from artifact generation and verifies clean source after build.
patches.integrationStatus: declaration-tested; complete isolated build pending

patches.purpose: Bind a build to its exact clean commit or base-plus-changed-file manifest, and emit the installed production dependency graph with package-provided license texts. Keep external runtime-asset notices separate and fail release review when the installed browser tree omits required material.
patches.removalCondition: Upstream emits an equivalent deterministic source identity and complete artifact notices for its installed production graph and downloaded runtime assets.
patches.integrationStatus: N10 source-stage review records 447 reachable production packages and 170 unique package-provided notice texts. The candidate remains an uncommitted source-stage worktree, and external asset notice omissions remain explicit release blockers; productionAccepted is false.

patches.purpose: Use the accepted Rinspace mark and application icons in the Rinspace release. Keep the browser-tab title synchronized to 芥子环在线编辑器 for Chinese locales and Rinspace Online Editor for every other locale without treating either application title as a document project name. Product attribution and TeXlyre licensing remain unchanged.
patches.removalCondition: This downstream release no longer uses Rinspace branding or upstream provides a configurable localized application-brand hook with equivalent project-name isolation.
patches.integrationStatus: The production build passed actual Chromium acceptance: the default English tab title was Rinspace Online Editor, changing the in-app locale to Simplified Chinese immediately changed it to 芥子环在线编辑器, and the accepted v0.2.4 Rinspace mark appeared through the reviewed local asset path. Public release and production consumption remain separate gates.
